title: Default model per vendor from the live /models list
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Stop pinning default model ids in config.default.json: choose the best served model per vendor at registration and re-check on rediscovery. Tests zc_default_models_*.
